children.text: This method supports SDK-style project files (
) do not support build-only environment variables.
The variable is available while Aspire builds the project but is not added to the environment of the launched project. Use
separately when the same variable is also needed at runtime.
Configuring a build environment causes Aspire to build this project separately from traversal groups.
so the launcher can consume the same build context. Aspire rejects legacy project-only IDE sessions because they cannot reliably locate output produced with project-specific build settings.
